map.差速驱动运动学：线速度 v = (右轮速 v_r + 左轮速 v_l) ÷ 2（: Differential drive kinematics: linear velocity v = (right wheel speed v_r + left wheel speed v_l) ÷ 2 (m/s); angular velocity ω = (v_r − v_l) ÷ wheelbase L (rad/s). Validation: non-empty valid-numeric guards for v_l, v_r and L; when L = 0 the division falls back. Criteria: no fixed grading; with equal wheel speeds ω = 0 and the robot goes straight, and the larger the speed difference the sharper the turn.
